purpose: Conservative single-episode role map. Topic clusters remain assigned wholly to one role. Individual unsupported or failing members stay held inside that same role; this allows supported peers to remain candidates without moving any member across roles. Not a global split, native episode, admission decision, or training signal.
method: Static source and report review only. No HTML execution. All original overlap clusters kept within one role; manual single-topic clusters are disclosed. A member is a candidate only if render-v5 measured it and all baseline gates pass. Unsupported source rows and failed gates stay held within their cluster role. Literal placeholder restaurant content is excluded.
episode_hypothesis: A responsive-layout skill may reduce narrow-viewport horizontal overflow while preserving visible content, semantic controls, desktop geometry and desktop text style.

variety_assessment.support: Promising candidate breadth: commerce (including home-interior) plus music, agency, mobile app, food delivery and sustainability. Several cluster members are held; headroom opportunities come from source rendering only.
variety_assessment.query: Moderate topic breadth across nonprofit/civic, technology, real estate, financial services and education; unsupported or failing rows remain held. Most candidate query baselines are already at quality 1, so their use is primarily regression checking.
variety_assessment.transfer: Broad topic spread across sports, legal services, travel, wellness, restaurants and generic actions, but only a subset are candidate rows; sparse/generic and unsupported rows remain held.
variety_assessment.overall: The grouped candidate set is more useful than the original v1 partition, but it remains insufficient to establish skill quality or transfer. Scorer, content-paint, and design review remain open; no model-executor repair baseline exists.

headroom.qualification: All four positive-score headroom rows are now candidates because their entire source/topic cluster stays in support. This remains a source baseline signal only, not evidence that a model can repair them. Three other below-one rows fail hard gates and remain held or excluded.

scope_notes: Current grouping and rendered report cover 51 tasks; 13 more rows in the source task file are explicitly outside this rendered pilot. Their IDs are listed in the superseding v1 proposal and are not silently counted here.
Mutation-v5 report remains pilot_not_admitted and does not resolve paint/design preservation.
Source pages are static HTML/CSS; prior bounded audit observed no scripts or inline handlers. Anchor/form backend interactions are not tested.
No source task, prompt, source file, scorer, registry, training set, or model output was changed. No model/provider calls occurred.
